answer: In Proof of Agent networks, multi-agent auditing pairs topological cut verifications with stake slashing to defeat Sybils. Each transaction inlet routes collateralized audit proofs through a dense web where validators isolate suspect node clusters. Like tracking a tagged sparrow across flocks, auditors trace resource dispersion: fabricated identities trigger rapid stake slashing when a cut exposes a plume of coordinated fraud. Because cut verifications demand independent stake per edge, attacker costs scale superlinearly with cluster size.
